utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’ll spread the word and line up a few helpers too. Thanks, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rey — I’m just waiting on Eli to finalize the list and timing, and then I can pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like Mara’s got the repair drive moving well. If there’s a first batch that needs picking up, I can grab it while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. Just keep me posted if the first batch’s ready, and I’ll bring any tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what repairs are needed for the drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m a bit swamped, but I know the repair drive’s still moving along. I’ll check the details and get you the date, time, and repair list soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Sam — can you bring your basic tool kit and a few spare screws? If you can help patch the loose fence panel, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring my toolkit and some spare screws, and I can patch the fence panel too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. Just point me to what needs doing, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Folks around here usually pitch in when there’s a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I still need the date, time, and what repairs we’re doing. Once I have those logistics, I can plan accordingly.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — I’ll send you the date, time, and repair list soon. You’ll spread the word once I do, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ve got the updated Sunday plan at the community center, and I’ll make sure Opal has the list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep track of the community center details and let everyone know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive. Let me know if you want me to bring any tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep track of what everyone’s bringing, and if anything changes I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli — I’m keeping it low-key, but I can help with the repair drive and handle the practical bits.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a big help, Uli — let’s keep it simple and practical. I’ll spread the word, and you can handle the hands-on bits.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—did the date or location change, or do you still need supplies?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No change yet — it’s still on for Saturday at the community center. We could use a few more extension cords and basic tools if you can help spread that around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m still in for the repair drive, Oren — just keeping it low-key for now. Once I’ve got the final date, time, and repair list, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Dane—just send the final date, time, and repair list when you’ve got it, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can check that for you—what details do you need about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Faye — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.
